rationale: The stock is caught in a deeply conflicted setup: strong Q3 earnings beat (positive fundamental catalyst) but trading down ~11% from prior close in a severe broad market selloff (SPY -3.45%, VIXY +20.87%), with price sitting mid-range at 37.3% of today's wide $63 range and oscillating tightly around VWAP ($359.27) and 9-EMA ($358.60) with no clear directional momentum in the last five candles. The spread is wide (41 bps) relative to the ATR-based move potential on a 1-minute basis, and the macro environment creates too much noise to confidently fade either the earnings strength or the macro-driven selling pressure.
